title: Swing Arm Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass, Double Arm | Satin Nickel | Assorted Wall Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Waverly Place 2 Swing Arm Towel Rail 12.5-Inch, Satin Nickel
description:
Keep towels within reach without giving up wall space—two pivoting arms swing out when you need them and fold close to the wall when you don’t in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. Designed for organized, flexible bathroom towel storage with a clean, finished look.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, tailored look: concealed screw mounting hardware
- Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 12.5 x 7.1 x 7 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 12 x 12 inches
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
- Wall-mounted; concealed screw mounting hardware included
- Collection context: Assorted Wall Accessories collection
- Style: transitional bathroom hardware with versatile bath accessories
multiple designer finish options available
